mentions.name: MemoryIndex
mentions.description: A web tool for tracking real-time market pricing of DRAM and HBM memory, with pricing broken down by equipment type, manufacturer, and other metrics.
mentions.source_excerpt: A better way to track real-time pricing of DRAM and HBM pricing in the market specific to equipment type, manufacturer, and other metrics. Feedback welcome to improve and see if there is a market for something more in-depth.

evidence.value: A better way to track real-time pricing of DRAM and HBM pricing in the market specific to equipment type, manufacturer, and other metrics. Feedback welcome to improve and see if there is a market for something more in-depth.
